study: Exploratory controlled information-resolution comparison, specified before high-resolution evaluation
splits: Reuse existing resolution_manifest indices. Verify original label ordering and audit exact pixel duplicates at 224 before fitting; stop on cross-split duplicates among retained cases.
comparison: Both branches start from the same official 224 image. Low-information branch: PIL bicubic 224->28->224. Same frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 encoder, same train/selection/calibration/test cases and same linear-probe selection rule. This isolates retained spatial detail conditional on this preprocessing and encoder; it is not the historical small-CNN comparison.
encoder: torchvision resnet18 IMAGENET1K_V1; frozen, eval mode, final 512D average-pool features; grayscale repeated over RGB and normalized with ImageNet means/stds; no additional crop
probe: StandardScaler fitted on training features only, logistic regression with L2, lbfgs, max_iter=3000. C in [0.01,0.1,1,10], choose smallest selection NLL separately per view. No fit on selection/calibration/test labels.
threshold: Inclusive 20th quantile of clean calibration confidence, unchanged rule, not tuned on test
primary: Test AUROC difference native224 minus downsample28-upsample224, paired test-representative bootstrap
secondary: Accuracy, NLL, Brier, ECE, sensitivity, specificity, coverage and accepted error; paired differences. Risk-coverage curves. No post-hoc choice of primary.
limitations: 224 is reduced from original radiographs, not native clinical resolution. Frozen ImageNet representation and deterministic linear probe, not end-to-end medical training. Known internal benchmark remains exploratory; no claim about full diagnostic sufficiency or external transport. Patient independence unknown.
